reason: I run a franchise, so head office has to approve any change a customer sees, and this company has no restaurants live that I could point them to. I'm not going to be the first to sign up for something I can't check against anyone else's experience.
objection: Who are you? A new company with no restaurants using it yet, asking me to put my guests' ordering and payments through you and get head office to sign off on it.
would_change_my_mind: A comparable sit-down restaurant already running Sora for a few months with the numbers to show, and written approval from head office.
